//: Lighthouse CI runs against the built static output (dist/client) so dev-server quirks never affect scores. The url list is EXPLICIT on purpose: with staticDistDir alone, lhci auto-discovers pages but caps at 5, testing a near-random subset. Listing URLs covers every distinct template and skips non-page stubs. Accessibility is a HARD gate (must hold 100); performance / best-practices / SEO are warnings so normal CI variance doesn't block a PR. Add a representative URL per template as pages are built. Every Family Hub route (including /family-hub itself) is SSR-only (`export const prerender = false`, session-gated) and is never emitted into dist/client, so none belong in this list — see tests/routes.ts, which excludes them for the same reason. Run locally: npm run build && npx lhci autorun
